gaps.description: REORDER_NODE, REPARENT_NODE and group/ungroup are not yet compiled by the production browser-descriptor to Python DesignOperation adapter. Layer tree intentionally does not fake persisted drag reorder.

Effective NODE-39 constraints are not yet projected with complete USER/BRAND/PROJECT/SYSTEM source, hard/soft reason and exact-version override capabilities. Missing source is displayed as UNRESOLVED.
Explicit update-token-target versus detach-binding mutation contract is not yet implemented. Bound visual properties remain read-only to prevent silent detach.
Full TextStyle/font-family/font-asset/weight/line-height/letter-spacing/alignment/color projection and licensed-font selection are not yet wired through the safe server compiler.
Browser E2E must verify Canvas↔Layers selection, property editing, server rejection, version conflict and explicit reload against a composed PostgreSQL Canvas service.
10k-layer browser performance acceptance is not yet measured. The pure virtual window contract is unit tested but requires real DOM/scroll/frame-time evidence.
Semantic role is visible but remains read-only until a warning/versioned role operation is supported by production Python Design IR.
Image crop, vector paint/stroke, effects, advanced layout and video-specific inspector sections remain future slices.
Hosted GitHub Actions evidence remains required. Previous repository workflows are affected by the same pre-run runner/account infrastructure blocker observed on preceding nodes.
